summary: Proofs are readable and adequately commented, but the new 57-line ramified proof buries a generic, reusable linear-algebra step inside an arithmetic theorem, and the extracted Basic.lean lemma proves the same nonzero-divisor membership twice within one declaration, adding two more copies of a proof that now appears five times in the file.
